meta.title: Katcha — Your own AI in KakaoTalk rooms
meta.description: Pick a role and connect an AI chatbot to your KakaoTalk room

demo.banner: You're exploring with sample data. Numbers are not real, and changes are saved only in this browser tab.

landing.title: Flow with AI, in your everyday conversations.
landing.subtitle: Pick a role and connect it to your KakaoTalk room.
landing.disclaimer: Katcha is not an official Kakao service. An operator adds a shared bot account to your room by hand.

create.title: Create
create.desc: Choose roles like AI Q&A, FAQ or notice drafts and set up a bot in 3 minutes.

connect.title: Connect
connect.desc: Once an operator joins your room, send a one-time code there to link it.

customize.title: Customize
customize.desc: Change the trigger, tone, length and prompt, with version history.

grow.title: Grow
grow.desc: Track handled messages and answer success rate with real numbers.

landing.howDesc: A chat link alone never auto-joins a room or proves ownership. People verify each step so the connection stays safe.

step1.title: Request a join
step1.desc: Send the room name, link and admin consent.

step2.title: Operator joins
step2.desc: An operator confirms consent and joins the room manually.

step3.title: Connection code
step3.desc: Get a code valid for 10 minutes and post it in the room.

step4.title: Ask with the trigger
step4.desc: Start a message with the trigger, like “!AI your question”.

landing.footerNote: Only messages that call the bot and its replies are stored. Regular room chat is never collected.

preview.promptSample: You're a friendly travel planner. Summarize plans and places briefly and accurately.

chat.title: Travel planner
chat.subtitle: Katcha AI connected
chat.a1: Great idea! For 3 days, try the east coast route and a market tour.
chat.a2: Grab street food at Dongmun night market, then walk by the sea.

login.subtitle: Connect your own AI to your conversations.
login.unconfigured: Google sign-in becomes available after Firebase is configured. You can explore every screen in the demo for now.
login.demo: Explore the demo without signing in
login.privacy: By signing in you agree to the <link>privacy notice</link>.
login.errorInvalid: We couldn't verify your sign-in. Please try again.
login.errorStale: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
login.errorSuspended: This account is suspended. Please contact the operator.
login.errorGeneric: Sign-in failed. Please try again shortly.
login.errorDomain: This address isn't an authorized domain for Google sign-in. Please contact the operator.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: A summary of what Katcha stores and why. Formal terms will be finalized before launch.

items.account: Your Google name, email and unique ID are used to sign you in and identify your account.
items.messages: Only messages that call the bot and the AI replies are stored. Regular room chat is not collected.
items.retention: Conversation logs are kept for 30 days by default (choose 7, 30 or 90). Raw error events 7 days, audit logs 180 days.
items.ai: Questions are sent to the selected AI provider to generate answers.
items.delete: When you delete your account, access is blocked immediately and deletion begins.

dashboard.subtitle: Better conversations, together with AI.
dashboard.connectHint: Connect a chatbot to a room
dashboard.triggerExplain: {bot} replies only to messages that start with “{trigger}”. It ignores regular chat.

chart.aria: Chart of daily handled messages and answer success rate

qa.title: AI Q&A
qa.desc: AI answers questions from room members.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.desc: Answers based on the Q&A you provide.

search.title: Web search
search.desc: Answers with search results as reference.

bots.title: My chatbots
bots.subtitle: {count} of {max} used
bots.limitReached: You can create up to {max} chatbots. Delete one you no longer use and try again.
bots.emptyDesc: Pick a role and create your first chatbot.

wizard.title: New chatbot
wizard.subtitle: Set it up in 4 steps, then connect a room.
wizard.restored: We restored what you were working on.
wizard.created: Chatbot created. Now connect a room.

stepDesc.basic: Enter the chatbot name and room details.
stepDesc.response: Set the trigger, tone and model.
stepDesc.review: Check everything and create the chatbot.

basic.name: Chatbot name
basic.nameHint: The account name shown in the room doesn't change. This name is for you.
basic.roomUrlHint: For reference only. A link never auto-joins a room or proves ownership.

roles.hint: Choose at least {min} and up to {max}. Even with several roles, the model is called once per message.
roles.faqHint: Write as Q:/A: pairs; they're included as answer context.
roles.faqPlaceholder:
Q: Where do we meet?
A: Every Saturday at Gangnam Station exit 3.
roles.customHint: Each save is recorded as a new version.
roles.customPlaceholder: e.g. You are a friendly travel planner. If unsure, say it needs checking instead of guessing.
roles.noticeNote: Notice drafts are written only when requested in the room. Scheduled posts aren't available yet.

response.triggerHint: The bot replies only when a message starts with this. English letters are case-insensitive.
response.noModels: No AI provider is configured. Please contact the operator.
response.dailyLimitHint: Maximum replies per day. Resets at midnight.
response.noAutoReply: The bot never replies to every message — only to messages starting with the trigger.
response.defaultModel: Default model (applied once an AI provider is connected)

review.guide1: The chatbot is created as “Not connected” and you'll go to room connection.
review.guide2: After you send a join request, an operator joins the room with the shared bot account.
review.guide3: Once the operator has joined, get a connection code and post it in the room.

test.title: Test question
test.label: Enter a test question
test.demoNote: Demo answer — no real model is called.
test.costNote: Calls the real model; usage and cost apply.

bot.pausedToast: Paused. The bot won't reply in the room.
bot.pausedBannerDesc: The bot won't reply even when called. The bot account stays in the room.
bot.deleteDesc: Disables the settings and starts deleting personal data. Removing the shared account from the room is requested from an operator.
bot.deleteConfirmDesc: It will stop replying in the room and its settings and history will be deleted. This can't be undone.
bot.promptDesc: Saving records a new version, applied to replies from then on.
bot.historyPrivacy: Raw conversations are not shown in the customer console.

connection.requestDesc: Send the room details and an operator will join with the shared bot account after review.
connection.accountDesc: The “{account}” account joins your room. Its name and profile are the same in every room.
connection.manualNote: For open chats, an operator joins via the link manually — usually within one business day.
connection.roomLabelHint: Helps the operator find the room.
connection.roomUrlHint: Don't enter a room password here. The operator will contact you separately if needed.
connection.loggingTitle: What's recorded and for how long
connection.logging1: Only messages that call the bot and its replies are recorded. Regular chat isn't collected.
connection.logging2: Questions are sent to the AI provider to generate answers.
connection.logging3: Logs are kept 30 days by default; you can choose 7, 30 or 90.
connection.permission: I manage this room or have the room owner's consent.
connection.notice: I've told room members about the AI bot and what it records.
connection.waitingOperator: An operator is preparing to join
connection.waitingOperatorDesc: After confirming the room owner's consent, an operator joins manually. You can get a connection code once it's confirmed.
connection.codeStepTitle: Post the connection code in the room
connection.codeStepDesc: The bot account is in the room. Issue a code and post it as-is to link this chatbot.
connection.codeExpired: Expired — please issue a new one
connection.codeWarning: The code only proves someone can post in the room, not that they own it. Don't share it. Issuing a new code invalidates the old one.
connection.pollStopped: Auto-check stopped after 5 minutes. If you posted the code, refresh.
connection.connectedDesc: Try asking in the room, starting with “{trigger}”.

rooms.title: Chat rooms
rooms.subtitle: Rooms your chatbots are connected to.
rooms.emptyDesc: Create a chatbot, then connect a room with a join request and code.
rooms.retentionHint: Applied within the platform's policy limit.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: Prompt version history for each chatbot.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Usage by date, up to 90 days.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage language, theme and data.
settings.localeNote: Interface language, AI reply language and room time zone are separate. Change the reply language in chatbot settings.
settings.dataDesc: Only bot-calling messages and replies are recorded; set retention per room.
settings.deleteDesc: Access is blocked immediately and deletion begins.
settings.deleteDemo: Accounts can't be deleted in the demo.
settings.deleteUnavailable: Account deletion becomes available after Google sign-in and the server are connected (S2).

validation.openChatUrl: Only open chat links like https://open.kakao.com/o/… are supported.
validation.faqRequired: Add Q&A entries to use the FAQ role.
validation.customRequired: Write instructions to use the Custom role.
validation.dailyLimit: Enter a daily limit between 1 and 1000.
validation.roomLabelMax: Keep the room name within 60 characters.
validation.permissionRequired: Confirm you manage the room or have the owner's consent.

errors.conflict: This was changed elsewhere first. Load the latest version, then save again.
errors.network: Check your network connection and try again.
errors.invalid_state: That action isn't available right now. Please refresh.
errors.botNotFoundDesc: It was deleted or you don't have access.
errors.pageNotFoundDesc: The address changed or the page doesn't exist.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

admin.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 4 characters.

overview.title: Overview
overview.dauDef: Based on sign-in or bot management

members.subtitle: Search members and manage status and limits.
members.suspendNote: Suspension blocks new AI requests and sending. Leaving rooms the bot already joined is handled as a separate ops request.
members.noImpersonation: Signing in as a member is not supported.

conversations.subtitle: Bot-calling inputs and AI replies. Raw text is masked by default.
conversations.revealed: Viewing raw text — recorded in the audit log
conversations.revealDesc: Viewing raw text requires permission and a reason, and is audited.
conversations.noReasoning: Model internal reasoning is never collected.
conversations.policy: Kept 30 days by default · regular room chat not collected · CSV export needs separate permission.
conversations.exportDesc: Downloads the last 7 days, masked. Requires a separate permission and is audited.

audit.subtitle: Record of operator actions. It can't be edited or deleted.
audit.readonly: Audit logs are only pruned automatically under the 180-day retention policy.

jobs.subtitle: AI and background jobs that failed or have an unclear result.
jobs.unknownNote: Delivery result is unknown, so it wasn't resent automatically. Check the room for duplicates first.

gateways.subtitle: Oracle relay status.
gateways.thresholds: Heartbeat every 30s · degraded after 90s · offline after 180s
gateways.unverifiedDesc: Real send/receive through Oracle, ReDroid, KakaoTalk and Iris (S0) hasn't been verified. Status shown is demo data.

join.subtitle: Customer requests for the bot to join. Confirm the room owner's consent, then join manually.
join.markedJoined: Marked as joined. The customer can now get a connection code.
join.note: Activation after code verification always requires operator join approval. Room passwords are never written to public logs.

appearance.subtitle: Upload, preview and apply Liquid Glass backgrounds. Cards, text and features stay the same.
appearance.uploadRules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20MB, at least 1600px wide. The server re-encodes it and strips EXIF.
appearance.badType: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP images are allowed. SVG and executables are blocked.
appearance.tooSmall: The image must be at least {min}px wide.
appearance.uploaded: Uploaded as a draft. Customers won't see it until it's applied.
appearance.inUse: A background in use can't be deleted
appearance.deleteLater: Asset deletion ships in S7 with server cleanup
appearance.panelNote: The glass panel blur (24px) is kept separately from background blur.
appearance.aiUnconfigured: No image generation API is configured. Uploads still work.
appearance.autoNote: Generated backgrounds go to review by default. If generation or the contrast check fails, the current background stays.
appearance.isActive: The selected background is currently applied.
appearance.demoApplyNote: In the demo only this list changes; the real site background stays the same.
appearance.tooComplex: This image is too detailed to meet the size limit. Try another image.
appearance.aiNote: Creates a low-quality {theme} background and adds it as a draft. Customers see no change until you apply it.
appearance.genReady: AI background added as a draft

genError.unknown: No response was received, so the result is unknown. It won't be retried automatically to avoid double charges.
genError.moderation: The request was blocked by the image policy. Change the extra direction.
genError.processing: The generated image couldn't be converted to background specs. Try again.
genError.other: Generation failed. Try again in a moment.

appearance.genBusy: A generation is already running. Try again when it finishes.
appearance.genBudget: This month's background generation budget has been reached.
appearance.autoPending: Scheduled generation isn't available yet. Generate manually and apply it yourself for now.

admin.liveNotReadyDesc: Your permission is confirmed. Real member, conversation and background data will be connected in the next stages (S6, S7). You can preview the screens in the demo.
